title: Task
summary: Composite source-linked DTO contract for the wrkq task surface. It documents the persisted internal/domain.Task JSON tags together with the snake_case wrkq cat --json / WrkqTaskCatView read projection layered on top, and cross-references the canonical camelCase RPC resource WrkqTask (internal/wrkqapi/types.go). Because it spans both persisted and read-projection fields, this artifact is composite: every field carries an origin (persisted vs read-projection) identifying its owning surface. domain.Task is the source of truth only for persisted storage-backed fields, not for the entire public API.

perspective.name: implementation contract
perspective.purpose: document the JSON DTO shape for a persisted wrkq task

assumptions: JSON field names are taken from internal/domain.Task struct tags.
Optionality follows Go pointer fields and omitempty JSON tags.
Enum literals follow internal/domain validation helpers and current task-table CHECK constraints.
Attribution is carried by canonical principal and scope refs; legacy actor-UUID caches remain only for backward compatibility and serialize when populated.
exclusions: The deprecated sdk_session_id database column is intentionally absent because domain.Task marks it json:"-".
Related comments, task relations, attachments, evidence items, role assignments, and transitions are outside this standalone Task DTO contract.
applicability.temporal: source snapshot at wrkq commit e57dc67 on 2026-06-28
applicability.operationalMode: normal wrkq task persistence and JSON rendering

excludes: HTTP daemon response decorators such as comments and relations
knownGaps: Descriptions summarize current source semantics; they are not a formal public API guarantee.

epistemic.note: Derived from current Go source, validators, and SQLite migrations.

provenance.note: WrkqTask is the canonical stable camelCase task resource DTO returned by wrkq.task.create, wrkq.task.show, and wrkq.task.list. It is a separate public surface from the persisted domain.Task and the snake_case cat read projection.

WrkqTaskCatView is the server-owned snake_case compatibility read projection for wrkq cat --json / wrkq.task.catView, carrying read decorators (path, artifact_dir, comments, relations, blockers). It is explicitly NOT the canonical RPC resource DTO.
domain.Task struct with JSON tags and database column mappings; authoritative for persisted storage-backed fields only.
Task kind, resolution, run_status, risk_class, priority, UUID, and timestamp validation helpers; ValidateState delegates to domain.ParseState.
domain.State wire type and ParseState lifecycle validation for the state field.
paths.Slug wire type, NewSlug constructor, and slug normalization/validation rules.
Runtime scope attribution column for task creation.
Canonical principal and scope attribution columns (created/updated/deleted) and legacy actor-UUID cache semantics.
Initial tasks table, task_seq friendly id trigger, timestamps, priorities, labels, and audit columns.
Task kind, parent_task_uuid, assignee_actor_uuid, blocked and cancelled states, and one-level subtask invariant.
Deleted lifecycle state and deleted_at triggers.
Cross-project routing, acknowledgement, and resolution columns.
Control-plane run linkage and run_status constraint.
Idea state and recreated task constraints.
Workflow preset/version/phase triple, risk_class constraint, and workflow task tables.
Task creation, update, lookup, re-parenting, and cascade delete behavior.

refs.note: domain.Task is the source of truth for the persisted storage-backed fields documented here; the canonical RPC resource is WrkqTask and the legacy read projection is WrkqTaskCatView.
Task fields are backed by the tasks table, except database-only sdk_session_id is not exposed in JSON.

notes: This is a composite contract: it documents persisted internal/domain.Task fields and the snake_case read-projection fields together; each field's origin (persisted vs read-projection) identifies its owning surface.

Source-of-truth rule: canonical RPC task resource fields come from internal/wrkqapi.WrkqTask (camelCase; wrkq.task.create/show/list); legacy/read projection fields come from internal/wrkqapi.WrkqTaskCatView (snake_case; wrkq cat --json / wrkq.task.catView); persisted fields come from internal/domain.Task JSON tags. domain.Task is not the universal public DTO source of truth.
required and nullable are independent dimensions.
Database-only sdk_session_id is omitted because the Task JSON tag is json:"-".
session_id is the JSON name for the cp_session_id database column.

Principal refs (created/updated/deleted_by_principal_ref) and scope refs (created/updated/deleted_by_scope_ref) are the canonical attribution fields after migration 000026; the *_actor_uuid fields are legacy caches that serialize only when populated.
created/updated attribution fields use omitempty non-pointer strings (absent when empty, never JSON null); the deleted_by_* fields are nullable pointers cleared on restore.
Read-projection fields are rendered by CLI/daemon read decorators and are not persisted on domain.Task.
